description:
Search the web and get a ranked list of results with title, URL, date and a short summary.

Use it when you need current or external information: recent events, documentation, prices, facts you are not sure about. Prefer one well-chosen query over many similar ones; if the summaries are not enough, call web_fetch on the most relevant URL instead of searching again.

Query rules:
- At most 128 characters. Write concise keywords, not a long question.
- Operators (combine freely):
  site:example.com      only results from that site
  -site:example.com     exclude that site
  lang:en               results in a language (e.g. lang:zh, lang:en)
  after:2025-01-01      published on or after a date (YYYY-MM-DD)
  before:2025-12-31     published before a date
- Example: "cloudflare durable objects pricing site:developers.cloudflare.com after:2025-06-01"

max_results: number of results (1-50, default 10). Asking for more does not cost more but uses more context.
include_content: include the full page text of every result. This is very large (often thousands of tokens per result) and rarely needed — leave it false and use web_fetch on one or two chosen URLs instead.

Results may come from a shared cache.
refresh: skip the cache and search again now; the new results also replace the cached copy for everyone. Billed at the full (uncached) rate, so only set it when the user needs the latest information or a cached result looks out of date.

include_content.description: Include full page text for every result. Very large; rarely needed. Default false.

max_results.description: Number of results to return, 1-50. Default 10.

query.description: Search query, 1-128 characters. Supports site:, -site:, lang:, after:YYYY-MM-DD, before:YYYY-MM-DD.

refresh.description: Skip the cache and search again now (full price); the fresh results replace the cached copy. Default false.

name: web_search
